# foxctl

> Go-based framework and CLI for code understanding, repo indexing, retrieval, context architecture, agent coordination, skills, and operational workflows.

foxctl documentation is written for engineers and AI coding agents working in
the foxctl repository or using foxctl as a local control plane. The pages below
are the highest-signal entrypoints for understanding the system, choosing
commands, and finding canonical behavior.

## Start Here

- [Overview](https://foxctl.com/start/overview/): First commands, safety posture, and main navigation paths.
- [Install and first run](https://foxctl.com/start/install-first-run/): Build and run foxctl locally.
- [Documentation map](https://foxctl.com/start/docs-map/): How current, planned, archived, and generated docs are organized.

## Core Workflows

- [Skills runtime](https://foxctl.com/skills/runtime-and-install/): Skill execution, installation, and runtime behavior.
- [Search and index](https://foxctl.com/retrieval/search-and-index/): How to choose semantic search, smart search, context grep, snippet extraction, and repoindex.
- [Repoindex and DAG grep](https://foxctl.com/retrieval/repoindex-and-dag-grep/): Build the repo graph, search it, expand neighborhoods, and render explanation subgraphs.
- [Repoindex model](https://foxctl.com/retrieval/repoindex-model/): Node kinds, edge kinds, IDs, summaries, anchors, and rebuild strategy.
- [Repoindex and PageIndex](https://foxctl.com/retrieval/repoindex-pageindex/): How PageIndex's table-of-contents retrieval idea maps to repoindex and semantic comments.
- [ACA context architecture](https://foxctl.com/context/aca/): How foxctl organizes repo context, memory, Obsidian knowledge, and retrieval evidence.
- [Context engine](https://foxctl.com/context/context-engine/): Typed evidence, retrieval episodes, impact edges, and staleness markers.
- [Memory continuity](https://foxctl.com/memory/continuity/): Task continuity, reusable memory, and session recall.

## Agents, Rooms, And Integrations

- [Agent lifecycle](https://foxctl.com/agents/lifecycle/): Agent daemon lifecycle and mailbox-driven execution.
- [Agent orchestration](https://foxctl.com/agents/orchestration/): Overseer, spawn control, and multi-agent planning.
- [Rooms](https://foxctl.com/collaboration/rooms/): Durable room collaboration and transport-first coordination.
- [Integration status](https://foxctl.com/integrations/status/): Current, in-progress, and planned integration surfaces.
- [Providers and MCP](https://foxctl.com/integrations/providers-and-mcp/): Provider configuration and MCP bridge setup.
- [OpenAPI and plugins](https://foxctl.com/integrations/openapi-and-plugins/): OpenAPI-backed calls and plugin integration.
- [Hooks](https://foxctl.com/integrations/hooks/): Hook wiring for shell, Claude, ACA, and task continuity.
